sections.title: Before booking in Chattanooga
sections.html:
If lipstick is the immediate concern, ask whether a single-group consultation is appropriate and what it excludes. For a full visit, plan for the stated four-to-six-hour duration and clarify whether product purchases are optional extras. Ask how the physical swatches relate to the makeup range and whether you can use them with products and clothes from other shops.

  • Am I reserving one color group or the complete draping service?
  • Are cosmetics included in the fee or purchased separately?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: An app can help you compare several color directions quickly, but it does not mix or apply a physical cosmetic formula. Use previews to decide which family you want to explore, then evaluate real products for finish, texture and wear. If you choose the studio service, record a few combinations you will actually use rather than feeling obliged to buy every recommended shade at once.
